doc: One wind bone: the lower or upper half of a stem, bending about its pivot.

fields.name: parent
fields.doc: Parent bone, or -1 for the root.

fields.name: pivot
fields.doc: Where it bends, in the rest pose (metres, clump space).

fields.name: axis
fields.doc: Unit direction along the stem, from the pivot.

fields.name: drag
fields.doc: Bend in radians at a steady 10 m/s wind.
